text:
sam: ran the quick mixed-slice pass on nova-lite-13b using int6 and a per-channel int4 hybrid. wanted to share cost vs quality notes.

nina: drop numbers pls.

sam: short summary: int6 latency p50 ~68ms (vs fp16 86ms), unit cost ~ $50/1M tokens (fp16 $118). hybrid(per-channel int4 on attention) lat p50 60ms, cost ~ $38/1M.

jordan: quality deltas?

sam: most slices: delta ROUGE-L within 0.6-1.2 points vs fp16. notable regression on "citation-preservation" slice (drop ~3.4 RL) and numeric-computation prompts (EM down ~2.8%).

nina: hmm citation-preservation is product-sensitive. how frequent is that slice in production?

sam: for GTN traffic ~4.5% of queries. for enterprise verticals it's higher (~12% in finance beta).

priya: from product POV we need a guardrail. options?

sam: propose: default route -> hybrid(per-channel int4) for cost/latency. Add lightweight signal checks before model selection: (1) presence of citations/urls (regex), (2) numeric-heavy prompts (>5 numeric tokens), (3) user tier enterprise. If any positive -> route to int6 or fp16.

jordan: can we compute perplexity cheaply as a signal?

sam: yes, but costs a tiny token of compute. alternative is a classifier with cheap embedding + logistic head. probably <1ms.

priya: what's the expected avg cost for hybrid with fallback at current thresholds?

sam: estimate: baseline hybrid-only $38/1M. With fallback to int6 for ~6% of traffic => avg ~$41/1M. Fallback to fp16 for 1% => +$0.5 so total ~$41.5/1M.

nina: that's attractive. What about quality-weighted loss? compute weighted RL delta?

sam: quick calc: weight by query volume and slice severity -> expected RL drop ~0.4 points weighted, EM loss ~0.6%. human-acceptability estimated ~ -1.1pts.

jordan: ops considerations? canary plan?

priya: yes ops needs: config flag in routing service, metric "quant_route_to_high_fidelity", 24h shadowing of fp16 for 2% traffic, alert if complaint_rate spike or quant_route_to_high_fidelity > 8% sustained.

deployer-bot: checklist created: 
- add routing flag: quant.hybrid.default=perchannel-int4
- add fallback predicates: citation_regex, num_token_count, user_tier
- metrics: quant_fallback_rate, avg_unit_cost
- canary: 2% traffic, 72h

sam: putting a minimal scorecard here (mock):
```
slice: general-chat         | FP16 RL 44.2 | HYBRID RL 43.6 | delta -0.6 | cost ratio 0.32
slice: citation-preserve    | FP16 RL 47.8 | HYBRID RL 44.4 | delta -3.4 | cost ratio 0.32
slice: numeric-reasoning    | FP16 EM 78.6 | HYBRID EM 75.8 | delta -2.8 | cost ratio 0.32
avg_unit_cost_per_1M: FP16 $118 | HYBRID $38 | INT6 $50
```

priya: recommend we run an expanded 200-case human eval for citation-preserve slice before full rollout. Nina will own the eval dataset.

nina: got it. I'll assemble 200 mixed-fidelity cases, include adversarial citation variants.

jordan: ML ask: can we try per-channel int4 only on feedforward and keep attention int6? might reduce that citation drop.

sam: good idea. I'll schedule a 36h sweep: configs = [int6 full, perchannel-int4-attention-int6, perchannel-int4-ff-int6, int4 full]. Will log metrics to the scorecard. Need 3xA100-80GB for 36h.

priya: GTN messaging note: highlight "~65% cheaper on typical chat workloads with smart fidelity rails to preserve accuracy on sensitive tasks." Draft needed.

nina: after human eval we can provide a short spec for enterprise SKUs: default hybrid, enterprise opt-in for guaranteed high-fidelity.

sam: lastly ops: set a dashboard tile for "citation-preserve RL" and "human_accept_rate" with 1w trend.

deployer-bot: reminder scheduled for canary check in 72h.

priya: thanks all. next steps: (1) implement routing flags + predicates (2) run per-channel sweep (3) nina runs 200-case human eval (4) ops create dashboard + canary. assign owners in tracker.

sam: starting sweep ticket now. will post initial numbers in thread when ready. :rocket:
